title: Automatic detection of cotton balls during brain surgery: Where deep learning meets ultrasound imaging to tackle foreign objects.
summary: Deep learning detects cotton balls as foreign objects in intraoperative brain ultrasound images, a specific surgical-safety detection task. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: Ultrasound images from brain surgery are used to train/test the detector against annotated cotton-ball labels; detection results are reported.
organization: Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine

evidence.tested: Deep learning detects cotton balls as foreign objects in intraoperative brain ultrasound images, a specific surgical-safety detection task.
evidence.unknown: External replication, causal effects and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
evidence.ai_role: Ultrasound images from brain surgery are used to train/test the detector against annotated cotton-ball labels; detection results are reported.
